description: This PHP file defines the QualificationLicenseController class within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin. It extends an abstract Vue controller and sets up a Vue component named 'license-list' during pre-rendering.

classes.name: QualificationLicenseController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for handling license-related views in the OrangeHRM admin plugin. Extends AbstractVueController to leverage Vue.js integration.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view before rendering by setting up the 'license-list' Vue component.
